title: CATBus signature object (public)
description: Optional hash-based signature attachment for CATBus envelopes. Private keys MUST remain off-bus. See docs/signing.md.

hash_alg.description: Hash used for message_hash / canonical bytes before signing.

key_id.description: Opaque seated key handle. Not a secret. Public examples only — never publish live fleet key IDs here as authoritative.

parent_hash.description: Hex-encoded hash of the parent envelope (sans signature). Omit on chain roots. Binds reply chains (hash-into-hash).

sig.description: Base64-encoded signature over message_hash (or canonical bytes — fleet must document which).

message_hash.description: Optional explicit hex message hash for debugging; receivers SHOULD recompute rather than trust this field alone.
